description: This file contains core functions related to handling attachments in the TestLink project, including retrieving attachment info, storing it in session, validating attachments, and managing file uploads and deletions.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfos
methods.description: Retrieves attachment information for a given object using an attachment repository, optionally storing it in session.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfosFrom
methods.description: Retrieves attachment information from an object that has getAttachmentInfos method, optionally storing it in session.

methods.name: storeAttachmentsInSession
methods.description: Stores attachment info array into session variable, appending or replacing existing data based on the counter.

methods.name: checkAttachmentID
methods.description: Validates the attachment ID against the stored attachment info in session to ensure its validity.

methods.name: fileUploadManagement
methods.description: Handles file upload process, including validating uploaded file, inserting attachment data, and logging events.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes an attachment after verifying its ID if required, and logs the deletion event.
